_provenance: Shape: OpenAPI domains/models/domain.yml (name, ttl, zone_file) and domains/models/domain_record.yml (id, type, name, data, priority, port, ttl, weight, flags, tag) (spec). Record names are relative to the zone ('@' for the apex); the records list filters by the full name (`name=www.example.com`) and `type` (spec, domains_list_records.yml). A new domain gets DigitalOcean's three NS records and an SOA (docs). Whether record data of host-name types comes back with or without the final dot, and the 422 text for a domain that already exists, are unverified: the provider compares host names without the final dot, and treats the 422 as CONFLICT. Values are illustrative.

domain.name: example.com
domain.zone_file:
$ORIGIN example.com.
$TTL 1800
example.com. IN SOA ns1.digitalocean.com. hostmaster.example.com. 1415982609 10800 3600 604800 1800
example.com. 1800 IN NS ns1.digitalocean.com.
example.com. 1800 IN NS ns2.digitalocean.com.
example.com. 1800 IN NS ns3.digitalocean.com.
